title: Debt Crusher
purpose: Debt Crusher is a private, forms-first financial operations console for managing cash accounts, credit cards, autopay funding, promotional balances, recurring cash flow, payoff priorities, forecasts, and review history.
features: Dashboard, Credit Cards, Cash Accounts, Setup, Monthly Review, and Utilities workflows
Prisma persistence with local SQLite and production PostgreSQL schemas
normalized financial operations model with legacy compatibility
additive migration, stable-ID backfill, verification, and rollback workflow
six-step manual setup and resumable monthly review
35-day cash forecasts, promotion pace, funding warnings, and cash-safe extra-payment guidance
workbook, JSON backup, and screenshot OCR utilities
pending_items: production Neon/Vercel rollout and authenticated end-to-end validation
explicit payment, balance-update, and cash-transfer event entry
richer historical comparison and unified timeline views
import preview, notification polish, and faster mobile entry
optional read-only Plaid connectivity to reduce manual updates
optional native iPhone Share Sheet intake
current_work_guess: normalized operations foundation and migration/review rollout
suggested_next_steps: rehearse the migration on a disposable database or Neon branch
add explicit payment and cash-transfer events
add richer month-over-month comparisons and strategy simulation
